stanza: The voice had been there all along
Hidden in the stones in the rivers
Hidden in the books
Hidden in plain sight
It was the voice of reason

books.line: He takes all his words from the books
stanza: There's bourbon on the breath
Of the singer you love so much
He takes all his words from the books
That you don't read anyway
I've searched the holy books
I tried to unravel the mystery of Jesus Christ, the saviour
I've read the poets and the analysts
Searched through the books on human behaviour

books.line: Tore the spines from out of all of these self-help books
stanza: Tore the spines from out of all of these self-help books
Made myself a gun that not only shoots but looks so real
Yeah, it shoots through steel with rays of darkmatter
Rays of darkmatter
And we all seem to need the help
Of someone else to mend that shelf
Of too many books
Read me your favorite line
I have my books
And my poetry to protect me
I am shielded in my armor
Hiding in my room
Safe within my womb
I touch no one and no one touches me

books.line: And the grey, damp filthiness of ages and battered books
stanza: Goddam' Europeans! Take me back to beautiful England
And the grey, damp filthiness of ages and battered books
And fog rolling down behind the mountains
On the graveyards and dead sea captains

books.line: Burn my uncle, burn his books
stanza: I'll burn my fingers, burn my toes
Burn my uncle, burn his books
Burn his shoes, cook the leather
Put it on me, does it fit
Me or you?
It looks tight on you

books.line: And they will run to the highest hill, consult their old books
books.linePrev: Half pushed but the puddles keep forming, don't fall in
books.lineNext: Ask the dead mystics for wisdom they don't trust

brookes.line: And I turned my gun on the bird-like Mr. Brookes
brookes.lineNext: I thought of Saint Francis and his sparrows

hooks.line: Dust off the old notebook where a younger Jermaine Lamarr wrote hooks
hooks.lineNext: To get a glimpse of what his hopes looked like back in his younger years

looks.line: Certain looks sort out confused looks
stanza: It's difficult not to worry about what happens next
Certain looks sort out confused looks
And certain looks sport confused looks

looks.line: And I already know how it looks
looks.linePrev: You don't want to bring it up
looks.lineNext: You don't have to remind me so much

looks.line: And think of all the books about Du Barry's looks
stanza: And think of all the books about Du Barry's looks
What was it made her the toast of Paris?
She had a well-developed personality

looks.songTitle: If You’ve Only Got a Moustache
looks.line: You may not have the looks
stanza: You may not have the looks
You may not have the dash
But you win yourself a girl, if you've only got a moustache
A moustache, a moustache, if you've only got a moustache!
